- [EVENT] User is considering travel insurance for their trip to Hawaii.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided information about different types of travel insurance policies available.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The three main categories of travel insurance mentioned are Trip Cancellation Insurance, Trip Interruption Insurance, and Travel Medical Insurance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional features of travel insurance mentioned include Travel Delay Insurance, Baggage Loss or Damage Insurance, and Travel Assistance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised the user to review policy coverage, limits, deductibles, pre-existing conditions, and policy duration when considering travel insurance.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested comparing policies from different providers to ensure the best coverage.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained that most travel insurance providers offer policies that cover trips to multiple countries.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned features to look for in multi-country travel insurance, including multi-country coverage, flexibility, trip duration, and policy limits.
